data.name: Shadow Mysteries
data.detailed_description:
Cook, craft, and stay alive in a world that changes every run. Follow a prophecy tied to the fate of the Shadow Realm while fighting creatures and learning how its biomes and systems work. New playable characters unlock over time, offering different ways to survive.

A pixel survival game about forgotten myths, corrupted magic, and trying not to lose your mind while the world falls apart.

About This Game

You wake up somewhere that looks calm — briefly. You have time to look around, gather a few things, and sort out what’s safe and what isn’t.

Shadow Mysteries is a pixel survival game about preparation, bad timing, and knowing when to stop pushing your luck. You gather, cook, and build small camps to keep you safe at least for a while. The world doesn’t explain itself, and it doesn’t care if you understand it yet.

Adapt to A Procedurally Generated World

Every death reshapes the world. The layout changes, but the rules stay the same.

Biomes shift, but their behavior doesn’t. Open grounds are calmer, forests are dense and unforgiving, swamps slow you down, and frozen lands punish poor preparation.

You won’t memorize maps here.
You’ll learn how the world behaves.

Survival Is More Than Hunger

You manage more than food and health. Darkness, moisture, cold, poison, and unstable magic all affect your resonance— your ability to stay focused and alive.

Choose Your Battles

Fighting is close-range and risky. Enemies can overwhelm you if you rush in, but defeating them provides meat, materials, and residual energy used for crafting.

You can craft and improve weapons and equipment to handle tougher encounters. Food and healing items help you recover between fights, making it easier to survive the next one.

Cook & Craft

Cooking isn’t just about filling the hunger bar. Different meals affect health, resonance, temperature, and sometimes things you’d rather avoid. Some food helps, some barely does anything, and some can poison you or make things worse if you eat it at the wrong time.

Crafting lets you build tools, stations, and upgrades, often using residual energy — a resource that fades unless you store it properly. What you choose to build shapes how long you can stay functional in a run.

Follow the Prophecy, Unlock New Survivors

Complete quests to fulfill the prophecy and unlock new parts of the world.

You’ll unlock multiple playable characters along the way. The Shadow Realm can’t be saved by a single person — restoring it requires unlocking other characters and completing their quests.

data.short_description: Survive the Shadow Realm, a changing world of forgotten myths. Gather resources, build a base, endure the seasons, and follow a prophecy through 13 characters, each with unique abilities and a story of their own.
data.supported_languages: English, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Russian, Japanese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3240, AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560 Ti (1GB), Radeon HD 7750 (1GB)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 (2GB), Radeon R9 380 (2GB)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
